seeding_rule: NPHS1 molecules are clustered by density (DBSCAN: radius 25 µm, at least 8 NPHS1 molecules within it, the molecule included). Clusters whose bounding boxes lie within 40 µm of each other are merged, repeatedly, into one seed per glomerulus; each seed box is the merged clusters' bounding box padded by 15 µm. NPHS1 seeds the boxes, so it never judges an outline.
rendering_rule: Gene-agnostic: each cell with a detected nucleus is a hematoxylin-purple disc of the nucleus's area (radius at least 1.5 px) at its centroid, on an eosin-pink background, at 1 px = 1 µm, softened by a Gaussian blur of 0.8 px. No gene and no cell type label is drawn. Crops are at most 1024 px square and hold whole seed boxes, at most 16 per image.
rejection_rule: Geometry only; no gene judges a proposal. A seed box wider or taller than 300 µm is rejected unsent (merged beyond one glomerulus). A proposal is empty when SAM 3.1 returns no mask or an empty one; rejected when its mask covers less than 0.1x or more than 2x the seed box's area, or its outline touches the image edge (clipped); fragmented when the mask has several pieces of at least 5% of its pixels (the largest is outlined; smaller specks are ignored); otherwise outlined.

proposals.reason: the mask has 2 separate pieces; the largest is outlined
